mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.type, r.product_id, r.order_id, r.rating, r.content, r.images, r.created_at, u.nickname AS nickname, p.title AS product_title FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE r.type = #{targetType} AND r.product_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY r.id DESC

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.type, r.product_id, r.order_id, r.rating, r.content, r.images, r.created_at, u.nickname AS nickname, p.title AS product_title FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.id DESC
